description: Defines the ForbiddenException class for handling HTTP 403 Forbidden errors within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin, implementing the HttpExceptionInterface from Symfony.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing HTTP 403 Forbidden errors, with support for status code and headers customization.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this exception, defaulting to 403 Forbidden.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code for the exception.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers associated with the exception.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the exception.
